name: Fire Opal Necklace of the Beastly Familiar

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

summary: Reference-only: while worn, cast Find Familiar once per dawn.
text: Reference-only: while worn, cast Find Familiar once per dawn. A Magic action transforms your familiar within 60 feet into a Tyrannosaurus Rex for 10 minutes. Retain alignment, personality, creature type, HP, and Hit Dice; other statistics use the Beast form. Equipment does not transform; unusable equipment drops. Gain the Beast’s HP as Temporary HP, which vanish on reverting; transformation ends early when these Temporary HP run out.
